pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
## Introduction
At Gourmet Gather (G.G), we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your data when you use our website and food delivery services.

## Information We Collect
We collect the following types of information:

- **Personal Information:** Name, email address / phone number, and delivery address when you place an order or create an account.
- **Payment Information:** Payments are confirmed through proof of payment (POP) sent on WhatsApp.
- **Order History:** Records of your past orders, preferences, and customisations to improve your experience.
- **Location Data:** Delivery address.

## How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:

- Process and deliver your food orders
- Communicate with you about your orders
- Comply with legal obligations under Nigerian law

## Data Sharing
We may share your information with:

- **Delivery Partners:** Your name, phone number, and delivery address to complete your delivery.
- **Legal Requirements:** When required by Nigerian law or to protect our rights.

We never sell your personal information to third parties.

## Data Security
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Your Rights
Under the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR), you have the right to:

- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate information
- Request deletion of your data
- Object to certain processing of your data

To exercise these rights, contact us at gourmetgather01@gmail.com.

## Data Retention
We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations.

## Children's Privacy
Our services are not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

## Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through our platform. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

## Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

- **Email:** gourmetgather01@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp:** +234 903 401 3321

pages.title: Refund & Issue Resolution Policy
pages.body:
At Gourmet Gather (G.G), we value your experience and strive to make every order right. Below is our official policy for resolving issues.

## Missing Items
If an item from your order is missing:

- Contact our customer service on WhatsApp within 24 hours of delivery.
- Provide a photo of what was received.
- If redelivery isn't possible, we'll issue a refund for the missing item.

## Incorrect Orders
If you receive the wrong item:

- Reach out within 1 hour with a photo of the item.
- We'll attempt to retrieve the incorrect item and deliver the correct one.
- If redelivery isn't possible, a refund will be issued for the incorrect item.

## Taste or Quality Concerns
G.G is Where Taste Meets Tradition:

- If no special instructions were given, we prepare the standard recipe.
- Refunds will not be issued for taste or quality complaints in such cases.

## Preference Errors
If your specific instructions weren't followed:

- Report the issue within 3 hours, with a photo or call.
- We'll attempt redelivery or issue a partial refund, depending on the impact.

## Order Cancellations
- Orders can be cancelled only before preparation begins.
- Once food prep starts, cancellations are not allowed and no refund will be issued.

## Order Modifications
- You may modify your order within 10 minutes of placing it.
- After that, the order is locked, and changes or refunds will not be possible.

## Spilled Items
If your food arrives spilled or damaged:

- Contact us immediately with clear photos.
- A partial refund may be issued, depending on the severity of the spill.

## Delivery Address Issues
- Incorrect or incomplete addresses may lead to additional charges.
- Always double-check your address before confirming your order.

## Need Help?
If you're experiencing an issue not covered above, or you just want to talk to someone on the team, please contact us via WhatsApp at +234 903 401 3321, or gourmetgather01@gmail.com. We're always happy to help and grateful for trusting us with your meal.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.body:
## Welcome to Gourmet Gather
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Gourmet Gather website and food delivery services (collectively, the "Service"). By accessing or using our Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our Service.

## Using Our Service
- You must be at least 18 years old to place orders.
- You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
- You agree to provide accurate and complete information when placing orders.
- You must not use our Service for any unlawful purpose.

## Orders & Payments
- All prices are displayed in Nigerian Naira (₦) and include applicable taxes.
- Delivery fees vary by location and will be communicated while finalising your order in chat on WhatsApp.
- Payment is required at the time of order. It validates the order.
- We accept bank transfers.

## Order Acceptance
Your order constitutes an offer to purchase. We reserve the right to accept or decline any order. An order is only accepted when we have confirmed your payment. We may refuse orders due to:

- Product unavailability
- Delivery location outside our service area
- Suspected fraudulent activity
- Errors in pricing or product information

## Delivery
- We deliver within Akwa Ibom State and its neighbouring states.
- Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to traffic, weather, or high demand.
- You must be available to receive your order at the provided delivery address.
- If you are unavailable, the rider will attempt to contact you. Unclaimed orders may be forfeited without refund.
- Incorrect addresses may result in additional delivery charges or order cancellation.

## Preferences & Allergens
Gourmet Gather is where taste meets tradition. We prepare meals according to your preference:

- If no special instructions are provided, we prepare the standard recipe.
- Please inform us of any allergies or dietary requirements in chat.
- While we take precautions, we cannot guarantee a completely allergen-free environment.
- You are responsible for verifying ingredients if you have allergies.

## Cancellations & Modifications
- Orders may be modified within 5 minutes of placement.
- Orders may be cancelled only before food preparation begins.
- Once preparation starts, cancellations are not accepted and no refund will be issued.
- For our full refund policy, see our [Refund Policy](/legal/refunds).

## Intellectual Property
All contents on our platform, including logos, images, text, recipes, and designs, are the property of Gourmet Gather or its licensors. You may not copy, reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our written permission.

## User Conduct
You agree not to:

- Use the Service for any illegal or unauthorised purpose
- Harass, abuse, or threaten our staff or delivery riders
- Attempt to gain unauthorised access to our systems
- Submit false or misleading information
- Interfere with the proper functioning of our Service

## Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by Nigerian law, Gourmet Gather shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of our Service. Our total liability for any claim shall not exceed the amount you paid for the specific order in question.

## Indemnification
You agree to indemnify and hold Gourmet Gather harmless from any claims, losses, or damages arising from your breach of these Terms or your use of our Service.

## Changes to Terms
We may update these Terms from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

## Governing Law
These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria.

## Contact Us
If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us:

- **Email:** gourmetgather01@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp:** +234 903 401 3321
